sentences.en: The largest recipient of Japan's ODA that year was China.
sentences.zh: 那一年，日本官方发展援助的最大受援国是中国。

sentences.en: The last time I went to China, I visited Shanghai.
sentences.zh: 我上次去中国的时候去了上海。

sentences.en: New facts about ancient China have recently come to light.
sentences.zh: 最近有关古代中国的新的事实被发现了。
